title: Print L2 sync status
summary: One-shot read of the rollup node's `optimism_syncStatus` — unsafe / safe / finalized heads, current L1 origin, and sequencer state.
audience: Anyone trying to figure out why the L2 head isn't where they expect it.
description:
The Home page already shows these numbers, but this dump is handy for grepping or pasting into a bug report. Hits the L2 CL node, not the EL.

A common cause of 'safe is stuck' is the sequencer being stopped — check the Home page's Sequencer indicator.
